definition.description: Generates SQL INSERT statements from a JSON array of objects. Supports customizable table name, column mapping, and batch inserts.

inputFields.helpText: JSON array of objects to convert to INSERT statements. Single objects are also accepted.
The SQL table name for the INSERT statements.
Number of rows per INSERT statement. Use 1 for individual inserts, higher for batch inserts.
Comma-separated list of columns to include. Leave empty to include all.
Comma-separated list of columns to exclude.

outputParameters.description: Number of columns in the INSERT
JSON array of column names used
